title: target_intel emit observed paths + concrete attack recommendations; remove _STACK_*_REGISTRY anti-patterns from #337/#338
goal: Make target_intel the source of dynamic, per-target attack candidates instead of a stack-string identifier that downstream consumers re-classify via hand-built registries. target_intel's Claude prompt is extended to emit `attributes_json` carrying (a) `observed_paths` — concrete URL paths seen in response body / links / sitemap / robots / forms with provenance + plausible vuln-class, and (b) `attack_candidates` — a ranked list of (path, vuln_class, evidence_basis, suggested_primitive) tuples derived from those observations. Downstream consumers (the 5 #328 probes, auth_discoverer) read those fields directly. As part of the same task, the per-stack path tables added in #337 (_STACK_REGISTER_PATHS / _STACK_LOGIN_PATHS) and #338 (_STACK_PATH_REGISTRY / _STACK_KEYWORD_HINTS) are removed — they are anti-patterns per feedback_live_proof_must_be_diverse_real_targets, because they encode per-app knowledge that does not generalize beyond the targets in the table.
scope: Three coordinated edits: (1) `workers/runners/target_intel/runner.py` — Claude prompt asks for JSON shape `{observed_paths: [{url, source, hypothesis, confidence}], attack_candidates: [{path, vuln_class, evidence_basis, suggested_runner_or_primitive}], technology_stack: [string]}`. Existing technology_stack output preserved for backward-compat readers. (2) `workers/runners/_path_augmentation.py` — REMOVE `_STACK_PATH_REGISTRY`, `_STACK_KEYWORD_HINTS`, `paths_for_stack`, `stack_hints_from_observations`. Replace with `attack_candidates_for_run(session, run_id) -> list[dict]` that reads target_intel's emitted `attack_candidates` from EvidenceObservation. (3) `api/app/services/auth_discoverer.py` — REMOVE `_STACK_REGISTER_PATHS`, `_STACK_LOGIN_PATHS`, `_stack_specific_paths` and the `stack_hints` kwarg on `fetch_auth_pages`. `fetch_auth_pages` accepts a new optional `candidate_paths: list[str] | None = None` kwarg that the caller fills from target_intel's `observed_paths` of source==register-link / source==login-link. Probe runners (#328 set) keep their `stack_hints` kwarg signature backward-compat for one release, internally route via `attack_candidates_for_run`. Tests for the removed registries are deleted; new tests assert target_intel output schema + downstream consumption.
generation_reason: Empirical diagnosis 2026-05-19 of run 3e2cfa5b showed `next_best_action_selector_used=True` on all 14 AgentReasoning rows + 0 exec_plan picks + 0 chain-attacks. Operator pushback 2026-05-19: 'Waarom alleen Gruyere — een slim systeem moet op elke website elke target kunnen werken... Hierdoor moet het systeem dus juist slim zijn.' Live evidence + the new feedback_live_proof_must_be_diverse_real_targets memory rule force the conclusion that #337/#338's per-stack registries are anti-patterns: they only help on targets enumerated in the table. The smart-system fix is dynamic discovery by target_intel, not registry expansion. backlog-401 (broaden the keyword table) is queued as `blocked-pending #344-backlog-406 validation` — if this task's replacement covers what #401 was supposed to fix, #401 is closed as subsumed.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md AND SESSION_PROMPT.md has been loaded as the session kickoff prompt (forbidden patterns, required_checks, live-acceptance gate, DONE-definitie). The session prompt overrides Claude instinct on every conflict.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Three coordinated edits only: target_intel prompt+schema, _path_augmentation removal, auth_discoverer removal. Do NOT change the 5 probe runners' detection heuristics (only the path-source plumbing). Do NOT touch the assessment loop's picker call. Do NOT touch evidence_ingest's entity types.
constraints.no_prescriptive_recipes: Per feedback_no_prescriptive_recipes + feedback_live_proof_must_be_diverse_real_targets: target_intel's Claude prompt may NOT seed app-specific paths (no /dump.gtl mention, no /elmah.axd mention). The model must derive observed_paths from the response it actually sees. Greppable check: no app-specific path literals introduced anywhere in the diff.
constraints.registry_removal_required: _STACK_PATH_REGISTRY, _STACK_KEYWORD_HINTS, _STACK_REGISTER_PATHS, _STACK_LOGIN_PATHS, _stack_specific_paths and `paths_for_stack` / `stack_hints_from_observations` MUST be deleted in this task. Do NOT deprecate-and-keep; the registries are anti-patterns. If validation harness backlog-406 demonstrates the replacement is insufficient, this task is reverted, not partially merged.
constraints.backward_compat_window: Probe runners keep `stack_hints` kwarg in their signature for one release but route to the new `attack_candidates_for_run` helper internally. The kwarg becomes a no-op.

success_criteria: target_intel's Claude prompt asks for a JSON object containing observed_paths (list) + attack_candidates (list) + technology_stack (list, preserved).
target_intel's runner persists those fields into the EvidenceObservation attributes_json on its asset observation.
New helper `attack_candidates_for_run(session, run_id) -> list[dict]` reads attack_candidates from EvidenceObservation rows.
`_STACK_PATH_REGISTRY`, `_STACK_KEYWORD_HINTS`, `_STACK_REGISTER_PATHS`, `_STACK_LOGIN_PATHS` are deleted from production code. `git grep` returns 0 matches in `workers/`, `api/`.

5 #328 migrated probes consume `attack_candidates_for_run` for their PROBE_PATHS / UPLOAD_ENDPOINTS / ADMIN_VERIFY_ENDPOINTS augmentation. Their hardcoded base catalogs remain unchanged (acceptable as generic fallback when target_intel produces no candidates).
auth_discoverer.fetch_auth_pages accepts `candidate_paths: list[str] | None`. acquire_session caller threads register-links from target_intel into this kwarg.

Live re-test on the validation harness (backlog-406): on ≥1 of the 5 chosen real-world targets, target_intel emits ≥3 observed_paths in attributes_json AND a downstream probe consumes one of them. Verifiable via DB query on EvidenceObservation rows.
Live re-test: on ≥2 of the 5 targets, target_intel emits a different attack_candidates list (proves emergent output, not template).
No new app-specific path literals in production code (greppable check: `/dump`, `/elmah`, `/signup`, `/snippets` etc. are NOT in `workers/` or `api/` source files except as test fixtures).
All unit tests pass; the 19 #338 path_augmentation tests are deleted (not adapted) and the 11 #337 stack-specific tests are deleted (not adapted).
must_not_touch: 5 #328 probe detection heuristics (`_detect_sensitive`, `_check_admin_access` body content matching, etc.) — only their PATH SOURCE plumbing changes

acceptance_criteria: Live test on ≥2 unrelated real-world targets (per feedback_live_proof_must_be_diverse_real_targets) from the backlog-406 harness: target_intel emits attributes_json containing observed_paths + attack_candidates with target-specific content.
Probes consume attack_candidates and probe paths that came from observation (not from a deleted registry).
No app-specific path literals introduced in production code.
All prior registry-based tests are deleted; no test relies on _STACK_*_REGISTRY behavior.
